name: fromJSON
title: Read JSON text or a file

origin.description: Parses a JSON string or a file path into vectors and lists.
origin.usage: fromJSON(content, handler, simplify, nullValue, simplifyWithNames, asText)

arguments.name: content
arguments.text: JSON text, or a path when the string names a file.

arguments.name: simplify
arguments.text: When a homogeneous array may collapse to a vector. Strict is the default.

arguments.name: nullValue
arguments.text: What JSON null becomes. NA lets null sit inside a numeric vector.

origin.details: Comments are accepted. An empty array slot is null. A trailing comma after an object value is an error, and a key with no value is null. The default reader stores every number as a double. A handler sees whole numbers as integers.
origin.value: A vector, a list, or an error for text that is not a container.
origin.example: Structures from fromJSON, one per line: vectors, objects, empty containers, a comment, trailing commas, simplify, a file, and two errors.
